title: Letter Addressed To The Secretary Of The Shanghai Municipal Council From Dr. E.P.H. Hibert

page_data.en:
Form 2
G. 3—11-32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
S.2, Special Branch.
Date 29th Jan. 1933.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. & S. B. REGISTRY. File No. ______ No. D 5522 Branch Splt.）

Subject (in full) Letter addressed to the Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Council from Dr. E. P. H. Hibert.

Made by D.S. Pitts Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the endorsement of the Officer
i/c Special Branch appearing on the attached copy of a
letter addressed to the Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal
Council, I have to report that Dr. P. Muto Nardone, who at
present works as a medical practitioner in conjunction with
Dr. E. P. H. Hibert at No. 212 Szechuen Road, has from
January 1, 1934 been appointed medical adviser to the local
Italian Legation, and as such will be more or less responsible
for the health of the local Italian marines, sailors, consular
officials, etc. He is therefore severing his connection
with Dr. Hibert in order that he may give his future post
sole attention.

D.S. Pitts

D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

File
[签名]
DEC. 8 1933

（左侧批注：JR）

报告
S.2，特别股。
日期：1933年1月29日。

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别股与搜查股登记室。档案号 ______ 编号 D 5522 分支 Splt.）

事由（全称）：E. P. H. Hibert 博士致上海公共租界工部局秘书的信件。

由 D.S. Pitts 编制 转呈 [签名]

鉴于附函（系致上海公共租界工部局秘书之信函副本）上特别股主管警官的批注，本人谨此报告，P. Muto Nardone 博士目前与 E. P. H. Hibert 博士在四川路 212 号联合行医，其已自 1934 年 1 月 1 日起被任命为意大利驻沪公使馆医务顾问，因此将或多或少负责驻沪意大利海军陆战队员、水兵、领事官员等的健康事宜。故他正切断与 Hibert 博士的合作关系，以便全心投入其新职。

D.S. Pitts

D. S.

特别股主管警官。

归档
[签名]
1933年12月8日

（左侧批注：JR）

page_data.en:
N 14/1.
POLICE FORCE FOR INFORMATION.
23 NOV. 1933
Shanghai, November 21, 1933.
SECRETARY OF ...
Dear Sir,
I beg to inform you that as from January
the 1st 1934 DOCTOR RUTH NICHOLS ceases to be
connected with me; and, accordingly, my firm will
be styled henceforward and for the time being as
DOCTOR HIBERT'S.
I beg to remain,
Yours truly,
Dr. Hibert.
page_data.zh:

供警务处知悉。
1933年11月23日
上海，1933年11月21日。
……秘书
尊敬的先生：
谨此通知您，自 1934 年 1 月 1 日起，RUTH NICHOLS 博士不再与我有关联；因此，本人的诊所此后暂命名为“HIBERT 博士诊所”。
此致
敬礼，
Hibert 博士。
